notes.title: Announcing: Final Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/acb5af78138cd2a953f9a83c2794a32d8e98abc4.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Today we have some news to share. We have launched a small update that fixes some minor issues players have reported over the last few weeks. On top of that we are also taking this time to announce that this will unfortunately be our final update.

While we are aware that there are still issues to fix, due to fact that this project is a student project, from now on development will indefinitely cease. Our team of student game developers has moved on to new projects and greener pastures. 

We would like to say one more thing though:

[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone that played Bone Voyage since our early launch in May. We are incredibly humbled by the feedback we received from our game launch and hope you have all enjoyed the game! We hope you all loved Arthur and his friends as much as we do.

[b]Signing off,[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/98b3bbefaa1ffc6fdb01fda5c84582fc60ff0d7a.png[/img]

tags.bug: We have launched a small update that fixes some minor issues players have reported over the last few weeks.

notes.title: Now Available: Game Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/93432942f53dc693149bffe50abb63be6580e55a.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Today we are proud to announce yet another update to Bone Voyage. This is, like all others, a good one! We have fixed quite a bit of bugs again and tweaked some things all across the game. Major update points:

[b]-Fixed issue in Quest 5 hindering game progression.
-Fixed a lot of the "Unexpected Issue" game dialogue issues.
-Overall performance improvements.
-Improved initial game on-boarding to guide players more.[/b]


The update should be rolling out across all devices just about... now!

We hope this solves some of the issues that players were having. Let us know if you run into any issues though. We are always on the look out for improvements.

Enjoy and greetings from,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/98b3bbefaa1ffc6fdb01fda5c84582fc60ff0d7a.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcing: Major Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/93432942f53dc693149bffe50abb63be6580e55a.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We are finally comfortable with releasing the next step in Bone Voyage's adventure. This update brings a large chunk of the changes we wanted the project to contain:

[list]
[*]Options Menu including graphical settings.
[*][b]Our first implementation of Saving and Loading![/b]
[*]Improvements to the stability of the dialogue screens.
[*]Issues resolved in the quests, meaning more content is playable.
[*]Camera improvements, making gameplay flow better.
[*]Extra content added to the deck and dinner.
[*]Overall graphical improvements to the deck and dinner.
[*]Performance improvements across the whole game.
[/list]

We are super excited to publish this update but do we want to remind everyone that saving and loading is still in development. Your progress in the game will be largely saved but you will still run into issues. When you do: please report them through the pause menu. On top of that, we want to make it clear that in the coming weeks [b]updates might invalidate your save-file.[/b] We are working hard to improve stability and will inform everyone when we are comfortable with announcing full saving and loading support.

Enjoy the update, and see you next time!

Greetings,
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/98b3bbefaa1ffc6fdb01fda5c84582fc60ff0d7a.png[/img]

notes.title: What's Coming Soon? Answered here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/acb5af78138cd2a953f9a83c2794a32d8e98abc4.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We have been hard at work making sure that the game becomes more stable. For now, we will have a few announcements: [b]Upcoming Friday we will release a new update.[/b] This update will be available on our Testing branch earlier.

The new update will feature some major improvements to the game, including (but not limited to):
[list]
[*] Options Menu including graphical settings.
[*] Improvements to the stability of the dialogue screens.
[*] Issues resolved in the quests, meaning more content is playable.
[*] Camera improvements, making gameplay flow better.
[/list]

[b]Thank you all for your patience, we hope you enjoy the game![/b]

Greetings,
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783296/98b3bbefaa1ffc6fdb01fda5c84582fc60ff0d7a.png[/img]
